recreation_brief: 1) Set slide background to white. 2) Place a yellow circle (~1 inch diameter) at the top-right with black text '49'. 3) Build the top table starting at left margin: headers x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 x6 Initial; row1 (1)(2)(1)(5)(6)(6) plus 'Initial W = [4, -2]' in the Initial column; row2 (1)(1)(2)(4)(5)(6); row3 (1)(1)(2)(4)(5)(6). 4) To the right of the table add red text 'REPEAT using Step η = 1'. 5) Add label 'Check classes of' and beneath it a 3x3 grid: Z1 Z1 Z1 / (0) (7) (3) / (0) (6) (2). 6) Add the legend line with 'C1 positive' in red, 'C2 negative' in blue, and 'Zero is unaccepted' in black. 7) On the left below the top band add the title 'Ugmented Vectors (from Top)' and a 4x6 table: row1 all (1); row2 (1)(2)(1)(5)(6)(6); row3 (1)(1)(2)(4)(5)(6); row4 (1)(1)(2)(4)(5)(6); beneath it place C1 C1 C1 in red and C2 C2 C2 in blue. 8) Below that add a red filled rectangle with white text lines 'Iteration 2', 'No change in W', 'Stop Iterations'. 9) On the right side create six evenly spaced horizontal calculation bands. For each band i (x1..x6) draw a light bordered box containing a 2-row matrix: top row [1, value, value, 5] and bottom row [-1, result], then the text '=> Keep same Weight', then a column vector W = [5, -1, -1]. Use these inputs/results: x1 [1,1]→3; x2 [2,1]→2; x3 [1,2]→2; x4 [5,4]→-4; x5 [6,5]→-6; x6 [6,6]→-7. 10) Keep all body text black except where red/blue color coding is specified.
